name: pin-mods
description: Three ways to keep a few lines pinned above the prompt in Claude Code: /pin, a Pin button under replies, and a checklist Claude pins on request

plugins.name: pin
plugins.description: /pin and /unpin: keep the last answer's steps, or text you type, above the prompt

plugins.name: pin-click
plugins.description: A Pin button under replies that have steps; show the original reply in the band; find it in the chat

plugins.name: pin-ask
plugins.description: Ask Claude to pin a checklist; tick the lines off in the band
